Assigns pilots and flight attendants to flights

Passenger booking with itinerary and fare
Document authorizing gate entry and boarding
Price structure for route and class

Move aircraft from gate to taxiway
Operate aircraft at altitude en route

All passengers aboard and door closed

Retrieve booking details by confirmation code

Get real-time departure and arrival information
List disrupted flights and rebooking options
Retrieve ticket change and refund policies
